title: mentha × villosa f. pascuicola
intro: Mentha × villosa f. pascuicola, commonly known as Woolly Mint, is a subspecies of the hybrid mint plant, known for its distinctive woolly leaves and purple flowers. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce nausea and vomiting, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mint include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and menthyl acetate, among other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
